subject.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options

question: Should the exported `resolvePollMaxSelections` helper reject zero- and one-option polls by throwing the established poll-validation error, rather than continue returning a numeric selection limit for invalid input?
rationale: This is a public plugin-SDK behavior change, and the evidence shows the helper is unreleased but does not establish which invalid-input contract maintainers want to preserve long term.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
options.body: Merge the PR and make the shared helper consistently reject polls with fewer than two options before channel delivery.

options.title: Keep numeric fallback behavior
options.body: Retain the current helper result for invalid counts and ensure each caller validates option counts before invoking it.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and make the shared helper consistently reject polls with fewer than two options before channel delivery.
